rows.en: Squeeze Voicer harder and make him spit it out!
Onikubi Island? That's what he said? Hunter Killer!?
That's right…
Then… Gavan's father is alive?

It seems Makuu is pushing ahead with something called Project X…?

And apparently it's deeply connected to Voicer.

Project X…?

Could it be the plasma energy generator invented by Tsukiko Hoshino's father… Dr. Hoshino?
Also… Makuu's Don Horror has reportedly appointed his son Sandoruba as the new combat commander!
Sandoruba?
We know nothing about who he is… Be very careful!
(Father… I'm coming to save you now! Please hold on a little longer.)

So this is Onikubi Island…

Makuu's secret base must be here! Father… must be held prisoner in that base!
Curse you, Gavan! Have you sniffed out our secret base? Buffalo Doubler, go!

Sandoruba! Listen well!

No matter where you hide my father… I'll find him! I'll rescue him, I swear it!

Torture upon torture, and he doesn't even flinch… What a man that Voicer is!

What we want is the blueprint of the laser amplification system! The Hoshino Space Cannon is already 90% complete!

Blast it… Throw him back in the cell!
Sir…

Nngh… Even truth serum doesn't work on him!?

An ordinary man would have dropped dead long ago! He's practically immortal, there's no other word for it!

If only we could get the blueprint of the laser amplification system…

Uuugh… If they inject me with that truth serum one more time, my life will… Agh…

I want to see him… my grown son… just one look… Gavan… Uuugh… Gavan!

Laser Scope!

…!?

That's it!

Is that the secret base!? Father is in there…

(…!?

This is the Hoshino Space Cannon? A system that turns solar heat into a laser beam!

Project X… blowing up planets with the Space Cannon!? How could they…!

…!?

A torture chair…?

They tortured Father for the Space Cannon's secrets? Damn you, Makuu!

…!?

And over here, a cell? It can't be…!?)
Father…!?
Uuugh…
Father! Hang in there! Father!
…Ga…van…
Father… I'm taking you to the TDF hospital right away! Hold on!
It's Dolgiran's special soup! It'll give you strength…
Thank you…
Uncle…

…!?

Tsukiko, is that you?
Uncleee!
I'm so glad you're well…
And you, Uncle… I'm so glad you're safe!

I kept the secret, you know! Your father's secret…

The Hoshino System amplifies solar heat tens of thousands of times! Used for peace, it would mean we wouldn't have to rely on oil anymore!
And Makuu wanted to turn it into a devil's weapon?

That's right…

That's why… I wanted to protect it no matter what.
You endured so much and managed to survive…
Even if they'd torn off my arms and legs…
I can't believe it… Enduring Makuu's torture and keeping the secret to the end…!
That's a Space Sheriff for you… a true diehard! Right, Father?

That's right! Hahaha…

Actually, you know… the amplification system's blueprint was never in my memory at all…

So no matter how much they tortured me, I had nothing to tell them! Hahaha…
Then where are the blueprints?
*cough, cough*…
Father…!

He still needs rest…

Gavan… maybe the blueprints are still in that secret base where your father was locked up?
…Could be.
Then… shall I ask Sharivan and Shaider?

Yes, please do!

Still… doing this to my father… I'll never forgive Makuu!
Gavan… Once I'm well again, let's fight together, all right? Against Makuu…
Leave Makuu to me! I'll hunt them down to the very end and make sure…
Heh heh… I'm going to fight too! *cough, cough*…
First, take a good, long rest… Then we'll see.
Gavan, why don't you rest a bit? You must be tired.
No, I'm all right! I want to stay with him the whole time! For as long as I can…
All right…
I wish I could have shown your mother… how big Gavan has grown…
Mother?
She died when you were six… She must be so jealous now, with the two of us meeting without her…
Let's go visit her grave. Once you're better, Father…
Earth is a beautiful planet. And Tamiko Ichijouji was a beautiful girl…
Father…
Father, Fatheeer! Uoooooh… Fatheeer!
What's wrong? Father? You survived Makuu's hellish torture…
The blueprint of the laser amplifier had been engraved into Voicer's skin. As long as his body was warm, the secret would never surface…
He kept on living to protect the secret. Your father…

Father…

From now on, I will protect the peace of this universe that you guarded with your life! Watch over me…

Voicer has been snatched away, and Project X has ended in failure…

Begone! Begone from Makuu Castle!
What did you say!?
As of today, I disown you!
But…
Begone, now! Or else…
Understood… Then I'll go on a rampage across the entire galaxy!

Try it, if you can!

The only reason anyone ever fawned over you was because you were my son!

Hahaha… The winds of space are cold! It will do you good to learn your own worth firsthand…
Nngh…
Begone, now!

Wait, please! Father…

We lure the super-dimensional high-speed craft Dolgiran to Onikubi Island, then ram Makuu Castle into it and crush it in one blow!

Without even giving him time to transform…

Even if Gavan manages to escape, the Dolgiran will be flattened…

Which means… he won't be able to use any of his future weapons! Then we drag him into Makuu Space and finish him off!
Hmm…
A last chance! Give me one last chance, Father…
Very well, try it!

uncertain: U10348/U10357: whole-line 『』 used for Retsu's inner thoughts; rendered as ( ) thoughts rather than "double quotes". U10357 has no closing bracket in the Japanese (next uid U10358 is absent); closed the parenthesis anyway.
U10340: Retsu is speaking to Commander Kom.
U10344: 星野博士 assumed to be Tsukiko Hoshino's father (glossary Tsukiko Hoshino, Ultraman); Voicer is her uncle (U10367).
U10378: 筋金入り rendered "a true diehard".
U10396: 二人だけで会ったりして - mother jealous that father and son met without her.
U10398-U10401: Voicer dies here; U10400-U10401 are narration-kind continuations of Retsu's line.
U10416: 蒸着 in a villain's plan rendered "transform" (not shouted).
omissions_kept: U10347: "Be very careful" addressed to Retsu.

new_names.why: place, not in glossary (reading uncertain; could be Onikobe)
organization, glossary has Makuu Space only
